review_method: Provisional agent visual assessment of five evenly spaced generated frames per 5-second clip, compared with the reference contact sheet. One trial per model; not a general model ranking.

runs.notes: Selected opening: preserves source two-eye black mascot, white field and flat graphic look. Colored characters arrive and settle. Deviations: black character remains large behind colored stack rather than shrinking into an equal team; mint shifts toward muted green. Use as an opening plate, then deterministic typography and team spacing. One I2V run; reference-image conditioning differs from WAN T2V.

Good cheap structural exploration: achieves small, ordered colored stack. Black mascot compresses into a thin disc and the model adds a ground plane/shadow, reducing fidelity to the flat reference. Lower-resolution output. Keep as alternate evidence, not the final opening.
